items.html: It turns out that his Guf was primarily above in Yetzira, as it is known that the Guf implies the Vav of HaVaYaH and Yetzira is also implied in the Ot Vav itself. The Raglaim of Adam ha Rishon were placed at the bottom four of the past Assiya which are now the first six of Yetzira. Thus we have explained the Hitpashtut of Adam ha Rishon in three Olamot Beria Yetzira Assiya when he was created.
